// diagnostic

E0905

Type doesn't implement required trait

What

Type doesn't implement required trait

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0905

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0905: tests/ui/core_math_value_type_mismatch.stderr.

Error [E0112]: `checked_add` wants Int (a whole number) for argument 1, but this is String (text)
  --> tests/ui/core_math_value_type_mismatch.jet:4:22
    |
  4 |     math.checked_add("one", 2).drop("type-mismatch diagnostic fixture")
    |                      ^^^^^
 Why: every argument must match its parameter's type
 Fix: use Int (a whole number) here
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0112

Error [E0112]: `abs` needs Int, Float, or F32, not String (text)
  --> tests/ui/core_math_value_type_mismatch.jet:5:14
    |
  5 |     math.abs("one")
    |              ^^^^^
 Why: absolute value is only defined for numbers
 Fix: pass an Int, Float, or F32
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0112

Error [E0905]: `min` needs comparable values
  --> tests/ui/core_math_value_type_mismatch.jet:6:14
    |
  6 |     math.min((n: Int) -> n, (n: Int) -> n)
    |              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: min/max compare their two arguments
 Fix: use Int, Float, String, Char, Bool, or a comparable type
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0905

Error [E0112]: `min` needs two values of the same type
  --> tests/ui/core_math_value_type_mismatch.jet:7:17

 Why: min/max compare like with like
